description: Sums the channels of a polyphonic input down to one mono output, with a compressor to even out the level as more or fewer channels sound

params.text: How much compression, to even out the level as more or fewer channels sound. At zero it is exactly SUM
Attenuates the output, which soft-clips at 12V

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are summed

outputs.text: The sum of the input's channels, on one channel
